title: Diorama picture tag scan is linear with identical matches
notes: The diorama markup tag scanner in apps/web/src/cards/art/dioramas/pieces.ts was rewritten for #4009 (ReDoS lint part 7): the old tag pattern scanned super-linearly on markup with no closing angle bracket, so it is now a lookahead-captured name replayed as a backreference. Matches are identical (fuzz-compared old-vs-new in pass 1); no picture renders differently.

player.title: Steadier card pictures
fixes: Pictures with damaged markup data no longer risk freezing the tab while their tags are read.
